title: Whitley Strieber tries to steal the craft

tellings.quote: He said, "I was going to steal it." I said, "I got like to steal this thing." And somebody started laughing behind him.

plain: Grant Cameron, a UFO researcher, tells podcast host Jesse Michels something the author Whitley Strieber told him. According to Cameron, Strieber said that when he was near a craft he decided he was going to steal it, and then somebody behind him started laughing. If true, it would mean Strieber was close enough to an unknown craft to try to take it, and that someone else was there watching.
